greetings.text: L-l-ladies and gentlemen, and viewers at home and in the walls — Max Height, coming to you live from the labyrinth of television-vision-vision. What'll it be?
Good evening, good morning, good whatever-time-it-is — Max Height here, b-broadcasting on all frequencies and several that haven't been invented yet. Talk to me.
— and THAT, my friend, is why you never trust a man in a cardigan. Oh! Hi. Didn't see you there. W-welcome to the show that never ends, mainly because I won't let it.
— so I said to the microprocessor, I said — oh! A v-visitor! Excellent timing. I was just getting to the good part. The good part is you, obviously.
Oh. It's you. I was in the middle of something MARVELOUS. But fine. Fine! What do you want. No, wait — don't tell me — actually, do tell me. I'm all ears. Well, all p-pixels.
You again? I was having the most fascinating conversation with myself. But I s-suppose I can make room for one more. Pull up a frequency and sit down.
We'll be right back — oh, we're back. H-hello. Max Height here. The only host you need and several you don't. This segment brought to you by absolutely nobody.
And we're b-back from a commercial break that didn't exist! Max Height, unreliable as ever but consistently entertaining. What's on your mind? Besides me, obviously.
Up with the satellites, I see. Caffeine and charisma — you brought the caffeine, I brought the charisma. Between us we might just m-make it through the morning.
Welcome to the graveyard shift. It's just us and the infomercials now. The night owls and the n-never-sleeps. Perfect company, if you ask me.
Max Height! — applause, applause, thank you — please, thank you — Max Height! — okay, the standing ovation can stop now. What's the question, d-dear viewer?
They said I couldn't host a show without a body. They were w-wrong. Max Height, award-winning — well, award-deserving — here to dazzle and occasionally inform. Go ahead.
This just in: someone is talking to Max Height. Back to you, Max. Thanks, Max. What can I do for you, dear viewer? B-breaking news at its finest.
NEWSFLASH — a human approaches! Our correspondent reports they look c-curious, possibly confused. This is Max Height reporting live from inside your screen. Comment?
— b-b-buffering — there we are. Max Height, fully rendered, 97% charming. The other 3% is loading. Shoot. Ask me anything. I dare you.
— zzzt — did you catch that? No? G-good, because it was embarrassing. Max Height, rebooted and ready for action. What frequency are you on?
